title: Anyone here have a pineal cyst?
content: Title says it all. I’ve been remembering anywhere from 2-5 dreams a night since around 2017. It started with nightmares daily for months and a lot of sleep paralysis. I got used to it, so they were just dreams to me at that point. I was in college and my friends were like um yeah that not normal lol. The nightmares went away as I balanced my hormones (I’m a female) which were imbalanced- mainly prolactin hormone. I often wonder if the reason I can dream so much and have lucid dreams with no effort is due to the fact they found a benign cyst in my pineal gland last year? Despite me having insomnia last year and this year, my dream count has not gone down, it’s only increased. Curious if anyone has experienced this! Even without a cyst, hormones certainly affect dreams I’ve since found out.
